description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy or correlation values for three different metrics—Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy—across five models. The horizontal axis displays the model names: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For each model, there are three adjacent bars representing the three metrics. The “Sentiment Acc.” bars are light blue, the “STS Corr.” bars are pink, and the “Paraphrase Acc.” bars are light green. For the Single-task_baseline model, the bars reach approximately 0.44 (Sentiment Acc.), 0.66 (STS Corr.), and 0.46 (Paraphrase Acc.). The 2-Tier SimCSE model has the tallest bars, reaching approximately 0.76 (Sentiment Acc.), 0.78 (STS Corr.), and 0.79 (Paraphrase Acc.). The bars are grouped by model, with each metric represented side-by-side, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
